title: Beyond Self-Consistency: Recursive Self-Improvement at Test Time
abstract: arXiv:2611.30965v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) that continue improving after deployment (e.g., recursive self-improvement) offer a promising path toward general intelligence. Current test-time methods pursue this goal on unlabeled questions, primarily relying on self-consistency: they generate independent solutions and use majority voting to select an answer or construct training targets. This leaves earlier reasoning unused at inference and can reinforce an incorrect majority during training. Humans instead build on earlier attempts to preserve useful reasoning, correct mistakes and improve their problem-solving strategies. Following this principle, we propose Test-Time Recursive Self-Improvement (TT-RSI), a label-free framework for improving LLMs at test time through two mutually reinforcing components: (1) In-Context RSI repeatedly re-solves each question using the full previous solution as a reference, letting the model decide whether and how to use

translated_title: 超越自一致性：测试时的递归自我改进
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.30965v1 公告类型：交叉  摘要：在部署后能够持续改进的大语言模型（例如递归自我改进）为实现通用智能提供了一条有前景的路径。当前的测试时方法在无标签问题上追求这一目标，主要依赖自一致性：它们生成相互独立的解决方案，并通过多数投票来选择答案或构建训练目标。这导致早期的推理过程在推断阶段被闲置，并可能在训练中强化错误的多数意见。而人类则会在先前尝试的基础上继续构建，以保留有用的推理、纠正错误并改进解决问题的策略。遵循这一原则，我们提出了测试时递归自我改进，这是一个无标签框架，通过两个相互促进的组件在测试时改进大语言模型：（1）上下文内递归自我改进，利用完整的先前解决方案作为参考反复重新求解每个问题，让模型自行决定是否以及如何利用……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了TT-RSI无标签框架，让模型在测试时以先前完整解答为参考反复迭代改进解题过程，从而超越传统基于多数投票的自一致性方法，实现大语言模型的测试时递归自我改进。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TT-RSI, a label-free framework that enables recursive self-improvement at test time by having LLMs iteratively re-solve questions using previous solutions as references, moving beyond majority-voting self-consistency.
